biotools.summary: DeepUMQA-X is a web server for protein single-chain and complex model quality assessment, providing estimates of overall, interface, and residue accuracy. It achieves top performance in CASP16 and CAMEO-QE blind tests, utilizing single-model methods and a consensus strategy.
